url: Official RadioDroid repository documentation and F-Droid listing
note: Short hints that drive live exploration. Deliberately a 14-of-32 subset in different wording from ground_truth.json - if the two name sets matched, the run would be graded against the list that drove it.

features.name: Browse popular radio stations
actions: Open the app
Tap on the 'Stations' screen
Scroll down to find the 'Browse popular radio stations' section
Tap on the 'Browse popular radio stations' option
Select a popular radio station from the list

features.name: Search stations
actions: Tap on the search icon in the navigation bar
Enter the name of the station in the search bar
Press the search button to execute the search
Select the desired station from the search results
Tap on the station to open its details

features.name: Stop playback
features.description: Tap the stop control in the player bar, the expanded player or the notification
actions: Tap the stop control in the player bar
Tap the stop control in the expanded player
Tap the stop control in the notification
original_actions: Tap the stop control in the player bar, the expanded player or the notification

features.name: Remove a station
actions: Tap on the 'Favourites' screen
Long-press the station you want to remove
Select 'Remove' from the context menu
Confirm the removal by selecting 'Yes' if prompted

features.name: View station details
actions: Tap a station
open its detail page

features.name: Open a station's homepage
actions: Tap on the station detail page
Tap on the homepage/website link
Select the station's homepage link

features.name: Record the stream
actions: Tap the 'Stream' button in the navigation bar.
Select the 'Record the stream' feature from the menu.
Tap the 'Start playing a station' button to begin playing a station.
Tap the record button in the player interface to start recording the stream.
Wait for the recording to complete and then stop the recording by tapping the stop button.
original_actions: tap the record button in the player (or the overflow menu

features.name: View the played-track history
actions: Open the navigation drawer
Scroll down to find 'History'
Tap on 'History'
Wait for the track history to load
Verify the track history is displayed

features.name: Set a radio alarm
actions: Open the navigation drawer
Tap 'Alarm'
Enter the desired time for the alarm
Select the desired radio station
Tap 'Set' to confirm the alarm

features.name: Import favourite stations
features.description: Open the navigation drawer or the Favourites overflow menu
actions: Open the navigation drawer or the Favourites overflow menu
tap the import option

features.name: Cast a station
features.description: Ensure the phone and the Chromecast are on the same network
actions: Open the RadioDroid app
Tap on the 'Station' option in the navigation drawer
Select the 'Cast' option from the station menu
Tap the cast icon in the toolbar
Ensure the phone and the Chromecast are on the same network
Tap the cast icon in the toolbar to confirm the station is cast
original_actions: Ensure the phone and the Chromecast are on the same network
tap the cast icon in the toolbar

features.name: Control playback
actions: Tap on the 'control' option in the navigation menu.
Select 'playback' from the dropdown menu.
Tap on the 'Start a station' option.
Pull down the notification shade to reveal the control panel.
Select the desired station from the list.

features.name: Adjust the streaming buffer
actions: Tap on 'Settings'
Scroll to 'Playback'
Select 'Adjust the streaming buffer'
Enter the desired buffer size
Tap on 'Save' to apply changes

features.name: Restrict playback
actions: Open Settings
Scroll down to find the network/metered connection option
Select the network/metered connection option
Scroll down to find the playback restrictions
Select the playback restrictions
Confirm the changes

readme_only.name: Leave any first-run analytics or settings screen
Tap Create Database or Open Database if shown
Enter a file name if asked and confirm Save
Reach the home or main screen
